reconcile.note: Matthew Henry distinguishes the human cruelty of invading armies, which God justly punishes though he permits it, from any divine command to commit such atrocities.

sides.snippet: their pregnant women will be ripped open.
sides.verseText: Samaria will bear her guilt; For she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword. Their infants will be dashed in pieces, And their pregnant women will be ripped open.\"

sides.snippet: they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron
sides.verseText: Thus says Yahweh: \"For three transgressions of Damascus, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; Because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron;
